{{Current events|year=2019|month=09|day=15|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack]], [[2019 Persian Gulf crisis]], [[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]]
**During a phone call, [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] reportedly tells [[Saudi Crown Prince]] [[Mohammad bin Salman]] that the "U.S. supports [[Saudi Arabia]] in its [[War on Terror|efforts to fight]] [[terrorism in Saudi Arabia|terrorism]]" and that the U.S. will cooperate in the aftermath of the oil facilities attacks. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/gulf/2019/09/14/Saudi-Arabia-s-Crown-Prince-receives-a-phone-call-from-US-President-.html (Al Arabiya English)]
**After accusations by U.S. and Saudi officials, [[Iran]] denies involvement in the attack and says it's "ready for war" against both the U.S. and Saudi Arabia after the Kingdom blamed Iran for backing the [[Houthis]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-aramco-attacks/iran-dismisses-u-s-claim-it-was-behind-saudi-oil-attacks-says-ready-for-war-idUSKBN1W009P (Reuters)]
**An anonymous senior [[Iraq]]i intelligence officer says the drones that attacked Saudi Arabia were launched from [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] bases in [[southern Iraq]]. The drones on that flight path reportedly would have crossed [[Kuwait]]'s airspace to carry out the strikes. Kuwait's government says it is investigating the sighting of a drone, reportedly flying low and hovering over [[Kuwait City]] on the day of the attacks. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/exclusive-iranian-drones-launched-iraq-carried-out-attacks-saudi-oil-plants (Middle East Eye)]
**An unnamed [[United States]] official says evidence suggests the drones approached Saudi Arabia from the northwest from [[Iraq]] or [[Iran]], contrary to the [[Houthi movement|Houthi militants]]' claim that the drones were launched from [[Yemen]]i territory. Three experts cited by [[CNN]] say the official's evidence is not conclusive. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-aramco-attacks/evidence-from-saudi-oil-attack-points-to-iran-not-yemen-u-s-official-idUSKBN1W00SA (Reuters)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/15/politics/iran-satellite-images-saudi-arabia-oil-attack/index.html (CNN)]
**Donald Trump says the [[U.S. military]] is "locked and loaded" after the attacks on its ally Saudi Arabia, but is awaiting confirmation from [[Riyadh]] on who launched the strikes before taking action. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/09/15/trump-says-us-is-locked-and-loaded-after-attack-on-saudi-oil-supply.html (CNBC)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[2019 al-Rai bombing]]
***A car bomb in the [[Syria]]n town of [[Al-Rai, Syria|al-Rai]], close to the [[Turkey|Turkish]] [[Syria-Turkey border|border]], kills at least ten people after it explodes near a hospital. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-blast/car-bomb-kills-10-in-syrian-town-near-turkish-border-local-council-medic-idUKKBN1W00O6 (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Price of oil]]
**Following the [[2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack|drone attacks]] on [[Saudi Aramco]] facilities, the price of benchmark [[Brent Crude]] oil [[futures contract]]s surges as high as 19.5% at market opening, the biggest increase in percentage terms since the [[1990 oil price shock]] in response to [[Ba'athist Iraq]] [[Invasion of Kuwait|invading Kuwait]]. [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/oil-prices-jump-19-attack-220539012.html (Yahoo! Finance)]
*Donald Trump authorizes the use of the [[Strategic Petroleum Reserve (United States)|Strategic Petroleum Reserve]] to "keep the markets well-supplied", following severe disruption to crude oil output in Saudi Arabia. [https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/461507-trump-authorizes-use-of-emergency-oil-reserve-after-saudi (''The Hill'')]
*[[Opioid epidemic in the United States]]
**U.S. company [[Purdue Pharma]] files for [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 11]] bankruptcy. Agreeing to contribute more than US$3 billion from the sale of a daughter company, the owners propose to settle thousands of lawsuits related to the risk of addiction to their narcotic painkiller [[Oxycontin]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/society/2019/sep/16/oxycontin-maker-purdue-pharma-files-for-bankruptcy (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A sightseeing boat capsizes on the [[Godavari River]] in [[India]]'s [[East Godavari district]], killing at least 12 people and leaving 35 others missing, all Indian nationals. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/india-boat-accident-dead-deaths-godavari-river-andra-pradesh-a9106306.html (''The Independent'')]
*A Transpacifico airplane crashes shortly after departing an airport in [[Popayán]], [[Colombia]] for a domestic flight. Seven of the nine occupants are killed. The remaining two on board are injured, as is a child on the ground. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/colombia-plane-crash-kills-injures-190916045919145.html (al-Jazeera)]

;International relations
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]], [[Israel–Turkey relations]]
**The [[Cabinet of Israel]] legalizes the [[Israeli outpost|outpost]] [[Israeli settlement|settlement]] of [[Mevo'ot Yeriho|Mevo’ot Yericho]], in the [[occupied West Bank]]. [https://www.jewishpress.com/news/israel/government-israel/israels-government-approves-establishment-of-mevoot-yericho/2019/09/15/ (''The Jewish Press'')]
**Referring to [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]'s [[Proposed Israeli annexation of the West Bank|proposed annexation]] of the [[West Bank]], [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Turkey)|Turkish Foreign Minister]] [[Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu]] says Israel is turning into "a racist, [[apartheid]] regime." [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-annexation-turkey/turkey-says-israel-becoming-racist-apartheid-regime-with-annexation-plan-idUSKBN1W00E8 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**Despite an official ban, thousands of people march from [[Causeway Bay]] to the [[Central, Hong Kong|center]] of town. Police use [[tear gas]] to disperse the protestors. [https://edition.cnn.com/asia/live-news/hong-kong-protests-sept-15-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2019 Tunisian presidential election]]
**[[Tunisians]] cast their vote in the first round of presidential elections. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-election/tunisians-vote-in-competitive-presidential-election-idUSKBN1W0058 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup Final]]
**In [[basketball]], [[Spain national basketball team|Spain]] defeats [[Argentina national basketball team|Argentina]] 95–75 to win their second [[FIBA Basketball World Cup|World Cup]] title. [https://www.news.com.au/sport/basketball/fiba-world-cup-2019-spain-win-gold-medal-in-crushing-win-over-argentina/news-story/4fc8cec2b4f24809e04d738a06efdd90 (news.com.au)]
